_comment: Rename this to <your-handle>.json and drop it in community-benchmarks/. The cohort + mode blocks are exactly what analytics/analyze.py writes as summary.json — paste them in. Add contributor / window / note yourself. Files starting with _ are ignored by aggregate.py. If you have no pre-skills history, drop the cohort block and keep mode — the jimat-vs-default delta still counts.
note: mostly TS/React work; jimat toggled on heavy days
